descriptionByLocale.en:
Senevita is the largest integrated provider of services in old age and employs around 4,300 people. Outpatient and stationary offerings merge seamlessly. While the Senevita locations stand for independent assisted living and comprehensive care, Senevita Casa is the leading provider of private Spitex services throughout Switzerland. For the Senevita Dorfmatt in Münsingen we are looking for an immediately or by agreement Assistant in Health & Social Affairs or nursing assistant in SRK 50-100 % Your tasks
• In everyday life you take over the competent basic care according to individual needs
• You comply with the hygiene guidelines and also take on domestic activities
• You lead the care documentation seamlessly and independently You bring that with you
• Training as a health and social assistant, nursing assistant, nursing assistant or equivalent
• Experience in a similar position, beneficial in long-term care
• Good oral and written knowledge of German
• You enjoy dealing with older people
• You work independently, are flexible and resilient We offer you
• Attractive further education offered by the Senevita Academy, which inspires ongoing development
• An environment where vocational training is written GROSS and brings a breath of fresh air into the house
• Free drinks and discounted food - heartily prepared by our gastro team
• Discounts (SBB half-ax, fueling, supplementary insurance, pharmacy, etc.)
• Good social benefits and at least. 5 weeks holiday (from 50 years 6 weeks, from 60 years 7 weeks)
• Exciting activities / events that move employees and residents
• Very good accessibility (motorway connection, location directly at the station Münsingen)
• Our commitment: You as a person are important to us! Interested? Does this passage speak to you? An enthusiastic and open team as well as warm residents are looking forward to you! Please send us your online application. For more information, please contact: Tasks
• In everyday life you take over the competent basic care according to individual needs
• You lead the care documentation seamlessly and independently Requirements
• Training as a health and social assistant, nursing assistant, nursing assistant or equivalent
• You work independently, are flexible and resilient We offer
• Attractive further education offered by the Senevita Academy, which inspires ongoing development
• Our commitment: You as a person are important to us!

 Deine Aufgaben

• Entwicklung nach Ausbildungsjahr:
 1. Jahr: Viel Anleitung, Fokus auf Grundpflege & Beobachtung.
 2. Jahr: Mehr Selbstständigkeit, erste komplexere Aufgaben.
 3. Jahr: Fast eigenständige Pflege, Übernahme von Verantwortung für Patientengruppen.
 Das bringst du mit

• Qualifizierter Bildungsabschluss: Du verfügst über ein Eidgenössisches Fähigkeitszeugnis (EFZ), eine Berufs-, Fach- oder gymnasiale Maturität, einen Fachmittelschulausweis oder einen gleichwertigen Ausbildungsnachweis.

• Leidenschaft für Pflege und Teamwork: Die Arbeit mit betagten Menschen bereitet dir Freude, und du schätzt den konstruktiven Austausch sowie die Zusammenarbeit im Team.

• Verantwortungsvolles Handeln: Du zeichnest dich durch ein hohes Mass an Verantwortungsbewusstsein und Zuverlässigkeit bei der Erfüllung deiner Aufgaben aus.

• Kommunikationsstärke: Du überzeugst durch ausgeprägte Kommunikationsfähigkeiten und eine kooperative, teamorientierte Einstellung.

• Aufmerksamer Blick: Dank deiner ausgeprägten Beobachtungsgabe erfasst du Veränderungen und Bedürfnisse der Bewohner schnell und präzise.

• Resilienz: Du bist sowohl psychisch als auch physisch belastbar und bewahrst auch in fordernden Situationen einen kühlen Kopf.

• Hygienebewusstsein: Eine saubere, sorgfältige Arbeitsweise sowie ein ausgeprägter Sinn für Hygiene-Standards sind für dich selbstverständlich.

• Flexibilität: Du bringst die Bereitschaft zu flexiblen Arbeitszeiten mit und passt dich den betrieblichen Erfordernissen an.

• Organisationsgeschick: Mit deinem Organisationstalent gestaltest du den Arbeitsalltag effizient und strukturiert.

• Sprachkompetenz: Du verfügst über gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift, um eine reibungslose Kommunikation und Dokumentation sicherzustellen.

• Überdurchschnittliche Ausbildungsvergütung: Wir bieten dir ein attraktives Gehalt, das dir finanzielle Sicherheit bietet und gewährleistet, dass du deinen Lebensunterhalt sorgenfrei bestreiten kannst.

• Kulinarische Versorgung: Geniesse hochwertige Verpflegung zu vergünstigten Konditionen in unserer hauseigenen Gastronomie.

• Exklusive Mitarbeiterangebote: Nutze vielfältige Vergünstigungen und Rabatte, beispielsweise für das Halbtax-Abo, beim Tanken, für Zusatzversicherungen oder in Apotheken.

Tirocinante/dipl. Lo specialista infermieristico HF Senevita è il più grande fornitore integrato di servizi per gli anziani e impiega circa 4.000 persone. I servizi ambulatoriali e ospedalieri si fondono perfettamente. Mentre le sedi Senevita sono sinonimo di vita assistita indipendente e di assistenza completa, Senevita Casa è l'offerente leader in Svizzera di servizi Spitex privati. Per la Senevita Giesserei di Arbon cerchiamo un tirocinante qualificato per il prossimo semestre autunnale. Specialista infermieristico HF nell'assistenza a lungo termine, nonché nello Spitex interno.
• I tuoi compiti Sviluppo per anno di formazione: 1° anno: molta guida, attenzione alle cure di base e all'osservazione. 2° anno: Più indipendenza, primi compiti più complessi. 3° anno: assistenza quasi indipendente, assunzione della responsabilità di gruppi di pazienti. Questo è quello che porti con te Titoli di studio qualificati: sei in possesso di un attestato federale di capacità (EFZ), di un diploma professionale, tecnico o di scuola superiore, di un diploma di scuola media superiore o di un titolo di formazione equivalente. Passione per l'assistenza e il lavoro di squadra: ti piace lavorare con gli anziani e apprezzi lo scambio costruttivo e il lavoro di squadra. Agire in modo responsabile: sei caratterizzato da un elevato livello di responsabilità e affidabilità nello svolgimento dei tuoi compiti. Forti capacità di comunicazione: impressioni con forti capacità di comunicazione e un atteggiamento cooperativo e orientato al team. Sguardo attento: grazie al tuo forte spirito di osservazione puoi registrare in modo rapido e preciso i cambiamenti e le esigenze degli abitanti. Resilienza: sei mentalmente e fisicamente resistente e mantieni la calma anche in situazioni impegnative. Consapevolezza dell'igiene: un modo di lavorare pulito e attento e un forte senso degli standard igienici sono per te un dato di fatto. Flessibilità: sei disposto a lavorare con orari flessibili e ad adattarti alle esigenze operative. Capacità organizzative: con il tuo talento organizzativo puoi rendere il lavoro quotidiano efficiente e strutturato. Competenze linguistiche: hai buone competenze in tedesco scritto e parlato per garantire una comunicazione e una documentazione fluide. descriptionByLocale.de:
Senevita ist die grösste integrierte Anbieterin von Dienstleistungen im Alter und beschäftigt rund 4'000 Mitarbeitende. Ambulante und stationäre Angebote gehen nahtlos ineinander über. Während die Senevita Standorte für selbstständiges betreutes Wohnen und umfassende Pflege stehen, ist Senevita Casa die schweizweit führende Anbieterin privater Spitex-Leistungen.

Für die Senevita Giesserei in Arbon suchen wir für das kommende Herbst-Semester ein/e/n

Auszubildende/ -r dipl. Pflegefachperson HF
in der Langzeitpflege, sowie in der hauseigenen Spitex.
Deine Aufgaben

• Entwicklung nach Ausbildungsjahr:
1. Jahr: Viel Anleitung, Fokus auf Grundpflege & Beobachtung.
2. Jahr: Mehr Selbstständigkeit, erste komplexere Aufgaben.
3. Jahr: Fast eigenständige Pflege, Übernahme von Verantwortung für Patientengruppen.
Das bringst du mit

• Qualifizierter Bildungsabschluss: Du verfügst über ein Eidgenössisches Fähigkeitszeugnis (EFZ), eine Berufs-, Fach- oder gymnasiale Maturität, einen Fachmittelschulausweis oder einen gleichwertigen Ausbildungsnachweis.

• Leidenschaft für Pflege und Teamwork: Die Arbeit mit betagten Menschen bereitet dir Freude, und du schätzt den konstruktiven Austausch sowie die Zusammenarbeit im Team.

• Verantwortungsvolles Handeln: Du zeichnest dich durch ein hohes Mass an Verantwortungsbewusstsein und Zuverlässigkeit bei der Erfüllung deiner Aufgaben aus.

• Kommunikationsstärke: Du überzeugst durch ausgeprägte Kommunikationsfähigkeiten und eine kooperative, teamorientierte Einstellung.

• Aufmerksamer Blick: Dank deiner ausgeprägten Beobachtungsgabe erfasst du Veränderungen und Bedürfnisse der Bewohner schnell und präzise.

• Resilienz: Du bist sowohl psychisch als auch physisch belastbar und bewahrst auch in fordernden Situationen einen kühlen Kopf.

• Hygienebewusstsein: Eine saubere, sorgfältige Arbeitsweise sowie ein ausgeprägter Sinn für Hygiene-Standards sind für dich selbstverständlich.

• Flexibilität: Du bringst die Bereitschaft zu flexiblen Arbeitszeiten mit und passt dich den betrieblichen Erfordernissen an.

• Organisationsgeschick: Mit deinem Organisationstalent gestaltest du den Arbeitsalltag effizient und strukturiert.

• Sprachkompetenz: Du verfügst über gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift, um eine reibungslose Kommunikation und Dokumentation sicherzustellen.
Das bieten wir dir

• Überdurchschnittliche Ausbildungsvergütung: Wir bieten dir ein attraktives Gehalt, das dir finanzielle Sicherheit bietet und gewährleistet, dass du deinen Lebensunterhalt sorgenfrei bestreiten kannst.

• Karriere & Entwicklung: Profitiere von einem breiten Spektrum an Fort- und Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten durch die interne Senevita Akademie.

• Kulinarische Versorgung: Geniesse hochwertige Verpflegung zu vergünstigten Konditionen in unserer hauseigenen Gastronomie.

• Exklusive Mitarbeiterangebote: Nutze vielfältige Vergünstigungen und Rabatte, beispielsweise für das Halbtax-Abo, beim Tanken, für Zusatzversicherungen oder in Apotheken.

• Work-Life-Balance & Absicherung: Verlasse dich auf attraktive Sozialleistungen und eine großzügige Urlaubsregelung mit mindestens 5 Wochen Ferien. Zur Entlastung erhöht sich dieser Anspruch ab dem 50. Lebensjahr auf 6 Wochen und ab dem 60. Lebensjahr auf 7 Wochen.
Interessiert?
Spricht dich diese Stelle an? Wir freuen uns auf deine Onlinebewerbung. Werde Teil unseres Teams und gestalte mit uns die Zukunft der Pflege bei Senevita! Bei Fragen steht dir Corin Fritschi, unsere Pflegedienstleitung und Stv. Geschäftsführerin, gerne zur Verfügung.

Aufgaben
• Entwicklung nach Ausbildungsjahr:
1. Jahr: Viel Anleitung, Fokus auf Grundpflege & Beobachtung.
2. Jahr: Mehr Selbstständigkeit, erste komplexere Aufgaben.
3. Jahr: Fast eigenständige Pflege, Übernahme von Verantwortung für Patientengruppen.

Anforderungen
• Qualifizierter Bildungsabschluss: Du verfügst über ein Eidgenössisches Fähigkeitszeugnis (EFZ), eine Berufs-, Fach- oder gymnasiale Maturität, einen Fachmittelschulausweis oder einen gleichwertigen Ausbildungsnachweis.

• Sprachkompetenz: Du verfügst über gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift, um eine reibungslose Kommunikation und Dokumentation sicherzustellen.

Wir bieten
• Überdurchschnittliche Ausbildungsvergütung: Wir bieten dir ein attraktives Gehalt, das dir finanzielle Sicherheit bietet und gewährleistet, dass du deinen Lebensunterhalt sorgenfrei bestreiten kannst.

While Senevita sites are synonymous with autonomous shelter and comprehensive care, Senevita Casa is the leading private service provider of help and home care throughout Switzerland. To strengthen our Senevita Casa Vaud team, we are looking for several:
CRS health auxiliaries in hourly contract
Regions: La Riviera, La Côte et Lausanne
Your tasks

• Relieving and supporting our customers in their daily lives and in the domestic economy

• Provide basic care according to the individual needs of our clients

• Accompany clients to the doctor, for shopping or for walks

• Ensure nighttime stays and watches

• Contribute to respectful, caring and secure care
Your profile

• Training of the Swiss Red Cross as a caregiver

• Professional experience in long-term care or home care (an asset)

• Stress resistance, autonomy and flexibility

• Good ability to use digital tools (tablet, mobile phone)

• You live in canton Vaud

• Having a driving licence and a car is an advantage
Our offer

• A varied activity adaptable to your occupancy rate (%) and availability

• The possibility of working in a very autonomous way, while being supported by an experienced and caring team

• Free access to the extensive continuing training programme of the Senevita Academy

• Various discounts (gasoline, supplementary insurance, fitness, pharmacy, etc.)

Want to make sense of your work? Join Senevita Casa Vaud and help provide quality support to those who need it. We look forward to receiving your application online.
Do you have any questions? Do not hesitate to contact us. Daniela MagnanatManagement AssistantSenevita Casa Vaud +41 21 311 19 20

Aufgaben
• Relieving and supporting our customers in their daily lives and in the domestic economy

• Contribute to respectful, caring and secure care

Anforderungen
• Training of the Swiss Red Cross as a caregiver

• Having a driving licence and a car is an advantage

Wir bieten
• A varied activity adaptable to your occupancy rate (%) and availability

jobs.description:
Senevita Casa è il servizio Spitex privato di Senevita, dedicato all’assistenza ambulatoriale a domicilio. Offriamo prestazioni personalizzate per favorire l’autonomia e la qualità della vita delle persone anziane nel proprio ambiente domestico. Come parte del più grande fornitore privato di servizi per anziani in Svizzera, Senevita Casa integra la nostra rete di residenze assistite e strutture di cura, portando supporto professionale direttamente a casa.
 Per la sede Senevita Casa Ticino –Regione Luganese -, cerchiamo da subito:
 Collaboratrice sanitaria CRS 120/ Assistente di cura AFC
 Profilo

• Diploma di assistente di cura, Attestato CRS120, attestato OSS 1000 ore (diploma Italiano) con riconoscimento della CRS

• Predisposizione per cure di qualità orientate al paziente, per la collaborazione interdisciplinare all’interno del team, per una comunicazione trasparente professionale e discreta.

• Pluriennale esperienza professionale nell'assistenza domiciliare ricoprono titolo preferenziale

• Flessibilità, affidabilità, precisione, puntualità, serietà

• Automunito
 Mansioni

• L’erogazione di prestazioni di cura a domicilio secondo i bisogni individuali

• Assistere e supportare i nostri clienti nella vita quotidiana e nella gestione della casa

• Accompagnare i nostri clienti dal medico, nei negozi, nelle passeggiate, ecc.

• Picchetti o veglie notturne
 Offriamo

• Attività assistenziale varia, autonoma e stimolante

• Orari di lavoro flessibili e adattabili

• Un team ben coordinato e collaborativo

• Opportunità di sviluppo professionale e formazione continua interna

We offer customized performance to promote the autonomy and quality of life of older people in their home environment. As part of the largest private provider of elderly services in Switzerland, Senevita Casa integrates our network of assisted residences and care facilities, bringing professional support directly to home.
For the headquarters Senevita Casa Ticino – Region Luganese -, let's look at:
Health worker CRS 120/ Care assistant AFC

Senevita Casa ist der private Spitex-Service von Senevita, der sich der ambulanten Versorgung zu Hause widmet. Wir bieten maßgeschneiderte Leistung, um die Autonomie und Lebensqualität älterer Menschen in ihrer häuslichen Umgebung zu fördern. Als Teil des größten privaten Anbieters von Seniorendienstleistungen in der Schweiz integriert Senevita Casa unser Netzwerk von betreuten Wohnhäusern und Pflegeeinrichtungen und bringt professionelle Unterstützung direkt nach Hause.
Für den Hauptsitz Senevita Casa Ticino - Region Luganese - schauen wir uns an:
Gesundheitsfachkraft CRS 120/Betreuer AFC

Für die Senevita Wangenmatt in Bern-Bümpliz suchen wir per sofort oder nach Vereinbarung eine/n Dipl. Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF 60-100%

descriptionByLocale.en:
Senevita is the largest integrated provider of services in old age and employs around 4,000 people. Outpatient and stationary offerings merge seamlessly. While the Senevita locations stand for independent assisted living and comprehensive care, Senevita Casa is the leading provider of private Spitex services throughout Switzerland. For the Senevita in Dorfmatt we are looking for an immediately or by agreement Dipl. Nursing professional with HF with RAI-HC responsibility 50-100% (also half-days possible) Your tasks
• With our customers you take on assignments in basic and treatment care
• You advise and accompany our customers and their relatives
• You carry out needs assessments with RAI-HC at the customer
• Spitexfall management and active cooperation in the expansion of our internal Spitex offering
• You create care documentation and the individual care planning You bring that with you
• Training for Dipl. Nursing professional
• Several years of professional experience in long-term care or Spitex region is advantageous
• You are accustomed to resilient, flexible and independent work
• You have completed the RAI-HC course or are ready to complete the course We offer you
• A varied activity and flexible working hours
• The opportunity to work very independently and exchange ideas with an experienced team
• Extensive training offer of the Senevita Academy, can be visited free of charge
• Unique culture and various generous employee events
• Various perks (fuels, supplementary insurance, fitness, pharmacy, etc.) Does this passage speak to you? We look forward to your online application. If you have any questions, the specialists listed below are available to you by phone. You want to sniff in first? We invite you to a non-binding coffee: Personal, relaxed and without application documents. You will get to know our team and get an insight into our premises. Make an appointment now: https://www.senevita.ch/en/locations/verarbeites-wohnen-dorfmatt-muensingen/employer/get to know coffee/ Tasks
• With our customers you take on assignments in basic and treatment care
• You create care documentation and the individual care planning Requirements
• Training for Dipl. Nursing professional
• You have completed the RAI-HC course or are ready to complete the course We offer
• A varied activity and flexible working hours

jobs.description:
Senevita ist die grösste integrierte Anbieterin von Dienstleistungen im Alter und beschäftigt rund 4'000 Mitarbeitende. Ambulante und stationäre Angebote gehen nahtlos ineinander über. Während die Senevita Standorte für selbstständiges betreutes Wohnen und umfassende Pflege stehen, ist Senevita Casa die schweizweit führende Anbieterin privater Spitex-Leistungen. Für die Senevita in Residenz Multengut suchen wir per sofort oder nach Vereinbarung eine/n Dipl. Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF 40-100% (optional mit Zusatzfunktion RAI-HC Verantwortliche/r)
 Deine Aufgaben

• Professionelle, individuelle Pflege und Betreuung nach festgelegten Pflegerichtlinien

• Du vertrittst bei Abwesenheit die Pflegedienstleitung

• Du führst Bedarfsabklärungen mit RAI-HC beim Kunden durch (optional)

• Gewährleistung einer vollständigen, fachgerechten und differenzierten Betreuung

• Du führst RAI-Assessments und BMF termingerecht durch

• Du erstellst Pflegedokumentationen und die individuelle Pflegeplanung

• Übernahme der Tagesverantwortung

• Teilnahme an Rapporten, Teamsitzungen und Weiterbildungen
 Das bringst du mit

• Diplomierte Pflegefachperson HF oder eine gleichwertige Ausbildung

• Gute Kenntnisse im Bereich RAI-HC von Vorteil

• Du stehst engagiert und motiviert im Pflegeberuf und gibst dein Wissen gerne an Kolleginnen, Kollegen und Lernende weiter

• Mehrjährige Berufserfahrung in der Langzeitpflege bzw. Spitexbereich von Vorteil

• Du bist selbstständig, kompetent und aktives Mitdenken ist dir wichtig

• Eine emphatische Begleitung der Bewohnenden ist für dich ebenso selbstverständlich, wie eine effektive Arbeitsorganisation und eine wertschätzende Zusammenarbeit im Team
 Wir bieten dir

• Umfangreiches Weiterbildungsangebot der Senevita Akademie kann kostenlos besucht werden

• Einzigartige Kultur und diverse grosszügige Mitarbeiteranlässe

• Vergünstige Verpflegung in der hauseigenen Gastronomie und kostenlos Kaffee, Tee, Wasser und Brot

• Arbeitsbekleidung wird zur Verfügung gestellt

• Verschiedene Vergünstigungen (Tanken, Zusatzversicherungen, Fitness, Apotheke usw.)

• Gute Sozialleistungen und mind. 5 Wochen Ferien (ab 50 Jahren 6 bzw. ab 60 Jahren 7 Wochen)

Spricht dich diese Stelle an? Wir freuen uns auf deine Onlinebewerbung.Bei Fragen stehen dir die nachfolgend aufgeführten Fachpersonen gerne telefonisch zur Verfügung.

Aufgaben
• Professionelle, individuelle Pflege und Betreuung nach festgelegten Pflegerichtlinien

• Teilnahme an Rapporten, Teamsitzungen und Weiterbildungen

Anforderungen
• Diplomierte Pflegefachperson HF oder eine gleichwertige Ausbildung

• Eine emphatische Begleitung der Bewohnenden ist für dich ebenso selbstverständlich, wie eine effektive Arbeitsorganisation und eine wertschätzende Zusammenarbeit im Team

Wir bieten
• Umfangreiches Weiterbildungsangebot der Senevita Akademie kann kostenlos besucht werden

• Requisiti Specialista infermieristico HF qualificato o formazione equivalente Una buona conoscenza nel campo RAI-HC è un vantaggio Siete impegnati e motivato nella professione infermieristica e felice di trasmettere le tue conoscenze a colleghi e studenti Diversi anni di esperienza professionale nell'assistenza a lungo termine o L'area Spitex è un vantaggio Per voi è importante essere indipendenti, competenti e pensare attivamente Il supporto empatico degli abitanti è per voi altrettanto naturale quanto un'efficace organizzazione del lavoro e un lavoro di squadra riconoscente
• Offriamo numerosi corsi di perfezionamento presso la Senevita Academy, frequentabili gratuitamente Cultura unica e vari generosi eventi per i dipendenti Pasti scontati nel ristorante interno e caffè, tè, acqua e pane gratuiti Abbigliamento da lavoro fornito Diversi sconti (rifornimento, assicurazione complementare, fitness, farmacia, ecc.) Buone prestazioni sociali e almeno 5 settimane di ferie (da 50 anni 6 oppure da 60 anni 7 settimane)
descriptionByLocale.en:
Senevita is the largest integrated provider of old age services and employs around 4,000 people. Outpatient and inpatient services merge seamlessly. While the Senevita locations stand for independent assisted living and comprehensive care, Senevita Casa is Switzerland's leading provider of private Spitex services. For the Senevita in Residenz Multengut, we are looking for a qualified nursing specialist HF 40-100% (optional with additional function RAI-HC responsible person) immediately or by appointment
• Your tasks Professional, individual care and support according to defined care guidelines You represent the nursing service management in the absence You carry out needs assessments with RAI-HC for the customer (optional) Guarantee complete, professional and differentiated care You lead RAI assessments and BMF on time You create care documentation and individual care planning Take on day-to-day responsibility Participate in reports, team meetings and further training This is what you bring with you Qualified HF nursing specialist or equivalent training Good knowledge in the area of RAI-HC is an advantage You are committed and motivated in the nursing profession and are happy to pass on your knowledge to colleagues and learners Several years of professional experience in long-term care or Spitex area is an advantage You are independent, competent and active thinking is important to you Empathetic support of the residents is just as natural for you as effective work organization and appreciative teamwork
• We offer you Extensive further training courses from the Senevita Academy can be attended free of charge Unique culture and various generous employee events Discounted meals in the in-house restaurant and free coffee, tea, water and bread Work clothing is provided Various discounts (Fueling, additional insurance, fitness, pharmacy, etc.) Good social benefits and at least 5 weeks of vacation (from 50 years 6 or from 60 years 7 weeks) Does this position appeal to you? We look forward to receiving your online application. If you have any questions, the specialists listed below will be happy to help you by phone. Tasks Professional, individual care and support according to defined care guidelines You represent the nursing service management in their absence You carry out needs assessments with RAI-HC for the customer (optional) Guarantee complete, professional and differentiated care You carry out RAI assessments and BMF on time You create care documentation and individual care planning Assumption of day-to-day responsibility Participation in reports, team meetings and further training
• Requirements Qualified HF nursing specialist or equivalent training Good knowledge in the area of RAI-HC is an advantage You are committed and motivated in the nursing profession and are happy to pass on your knowledge to colleagues and learners Several years of professional experience in long-term care or Spitex area is an advantage You are independent, competent and active thinking is important to you Empathetic support of the residents is just as natural for you as effective work organization and appreciative teamwork
• We offer extensive further training courses at the Senevita Academy can be attended free of charge Unique culture and various generous employee events Discounted meals in the in-house restaurant and free coffee, tea, water and bread Work clothing is provided Various discounts (Fueling, additional insurance, fitness, pharmacy, etc.) Good social benefits and at least 5 weeks of vacation (from 50 years 6 or from 60 years 7 weeks)

jobs.description:
Senevita ist die grösste integrierte Anbieterin von Dienstleistungen im Alter und beschäftigt rund 4'000 Mitarbeitende. Ambulante und stationäre Angebote gehen nahtlos ineinander über. Während die Senevita Standorte für selbstständiges betreutes Wohnen und umfassende Pflege stehen, ist Senevita Casa die schweizweit führende Anbieterin privater Spitex-Leistungen . Für die Senevita Casa Obwalden und Nidwalden in Sarnen suchen wir nach Vereinbarung eine Dipl. Pflegefachperson HF 40 - 100%
 Dein wichtiger Beitrag

• Du spielst eine massgebliche Rolle dabei, sicherzustellen, dass unsere Kundinnen und Kunden zu Hause eine ganzheitliche, erstklassige und individuelle Bezugspflege geniessen

• Du stehst Angehörigen und den zu betreuenden Personen sowie dem Team in allen Fragen rund um die Pflege zu Seite

• Du arbeitest und koordinierst die interdisziplinäre Zusammenarbeit mit Ärzten, Krankenkassen und dem Team
 Hiermit bereicherst du unser Team

• Du hast eine tertiäre Ausbildung in der Pflege (HF, FH, AKP, DN II, auch DNI und FA und -betreuung)

• Deine Flexibilität und Einsatzbereitschaft machen dich zu einer zuverlässigen Stütze im Team

• Deine guten mündlichen und schriftlichen Deutschkenntnisse helfen dir mit den Menschen um dich herum zu kommunizieren

• Dein Verantwortungsbewusstsein und die Fähigkeit, Notfallsituationen zu erkennen und darin angemessen zu reagieren, machen dich zu einem wertvollen Teammitglied

• Deine fröhliche Art ist ansteckend und trägt aktiv zu einer positiven Betriebskultur bei, die unsere Kunden begeistert und das Arbeitsumfeld bereichert

• Du verfügst Du über den InterRAI HC Kurs oder hast die Bereitschaft diesen zu absolvieren
 Worauf wir stolz sind

• Unsere Priorität liegt in der persönlichen Kundenbetreuung und in der Kontinuität durch fixe Pflegepersonen. Dabei setzen wir auf den Aufbau langfristiger Beziehungen.

• Wir bieten Flexibilität bei der Einsatzplanung

• Die Anstellung ist im Stundenlohn sowie im Monatslohn möglich

• Du arbeitest eigenständig und bist trotzdem nicht alleine – bei der Arbeitsgestaltung hast du Freiheiten, im Team den Erfahrungsaustausch und gegenseitige Unterstützung

• Das umfangreiche Weiterbildungsangebot der Senevita Akademie ist für unsere Mitarbeitenden kostenlos

• Wir bieten ausserdem lukrative Mitarbeiterbenefits & Partnervorteile

Du bist empathisch, deine Leidenschaft gilt der Pflege von Menschen? Dann bist du bei uns genau richtig! Wir freuen uns auf deine Online-Bewerbung!         Weitere Auskünfte erteilt dir gerne Nikson Preqi, Standortleiter.

Aufgaben
• Du spielst eine massgebliche Rolle dabei, sicherzustellen, dass unsere Kundinnen und Kunden zu Hause eine ganzheitliche, erstklassige und individuelle Bezugspflege geniessen

• Du arbeitest und koordinierst die interdisziplinäre Zusammenarbeit mit Ärzten, Krankenkassen und dem Team

Anforderungen
• Du hast eine tertiäre Ausbildung in der Pflege (HF, FH, AKP, DN II, auch DNI und FA und -betreuung)

• Du verfügst Du über den InterRAI HC Kurs oder hast die Bereitschaft diesen zu absolvieren

Wir bieten
• Unsere Priorität liegt in der persönlichen Kundenbetreuung und in der Kontinuität durch fixe Pflegepersonen. Dabei setzen wir auf den Aufbau langfristiger Beziehungen.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Senevita è il più grande fornitore integrato di servizi in età avanzata e impiega circa 4.000 persone. Le offerte ambulatoriale e stazionario si fondono senza soluzione di continuità. Mentre le sedi di Senevita sono per la vita assistita indipendente e la cura completa, Senevita Casa è il fornitore leader di servizi privati Spitex in Svizzera. Per la Senevita Casa Obwalden e Nidwalden a Sarnen stiamo cercando un Dipl. Professionista HF 40 - 100%
Il tuo importante contributo

• Si gioca un ruolo chiave nel garantire che i nostri clienti godono di una cura olistica, di prima classe e individuale a casa.

• Sosterrete i parenti e le persone per essere curati e la squadra in tutte le questioni riguardanti la cura

• Lei lavora e coordina la cooperazione interdisciplinare con medici, compagnie di assicurazione sanitaria e il team
Con questo arricchisci il nostro team

• Hai una formazione terziaria in allattamento (HF, FH, AKP, DN II, DNI e FA e cura)

• La flessibilità e l'impegno ti rendono un supporto affidabile nel team

• Le tue buone abilità tedesche orali e scritte ti aiuteranno a comunicare con le persone che ti circondano

• Il tuo senso di responsabilità e la capacità di identificare e rispondere in modo appropriato alle situazioni di emergenza ti rendono un membro di squadra prezioso.

• La vostra natura allegra è contagiosa e contribuisce attivamente ad una cultura aziendale positiva che ispira i nostri clienti e arricchisce l'ambiente di lavoro

• Sei sul corso InterRAI HC o hai la volontà di completarlo
Che cosa siamo orgogliosi di

• La nostra priorità è il supporto personale del cliente e la continuità attraverso caregiver fissi. Ci concentriamo sulla costruzione di relazioni a lungo termine.

• Offriamo flessibilità nella pianificazione operativa

• L'occupazione è possibile nel salario orario e nel salario mensile

• Lavorate in modo indipendente e non siete ancora soli – nella progettazione del lavoro avete libertà, nel team lo scambio di esperienze e il reciproco sostegno

• L'ampia offerta di formazione dell'Accademia Senevita è gratuita per i nostri dipendenti

• Offriamo anche benefici lucrativi per i dipendenti e vantaggi per i partner

Sei empatico, la tua passione è prenderti cura delle persone? Allora hai proprio ragione con noi! Non vediamo l'ora della tua applicazione online! Ulteriori informazioni possono essere fornite da Nikson Preqi, gestore del sito.

Compiti
• Si gioca un ruolo chiave nel garantire che i nostri clienti godono di una cura olistica, di prima classe e individuale a casa.

• Lei lavora e coordina la cooperazione interdisciplinare con medici, compagnie di assicurazione sanitaria e il team

Requisiti
• Hai una formazione terziaria in allattamento (HF, FH, AKP, DN II, DNI e FA e cura)

• Sei sul corso InterRAI HC o hai la volontà di completarlo

Offriamo
• La nostra priorità è il supporto personale del cliente e la continuità attraverso caregiver fissi. Ci concentriamo sulla costruzione di relazioni a lungo termine.
descriptionByLocale.en:
Senevita is the largest integrated provider of services in old age and employs around 4,000 people. Outpatient and stationary offerings merge seamlessly. While the Senevita locations stand for independent assisted living and comprehensive care, Senevita Casa is the leading provider of private Spitex services in Switzerland. For the Senevita Casa Obwalden and Nidwalden in Sarnen we are looking for a Dipl. Care professional HF 40 - 100%
Your important contribution

• You play a key role in ensuring that our customers enjoy a holistic, first-class and individual care at home.

• You will support relatives and the persons to be cared for as well as the team in all matters concerning care

• You work and coordinate the interdisciplinary cooperation with doctors, health insurance companies and the team
With this you enrich our team

• You have a tertiary education in nursing (HF, FH, AKP, DN II, also DNI and FA and care)

• Your flexibility and commitment make you a reliable support in the team

• Your good oral and written German skills will help you communicate with the people around you

• Your sense of responsibility and ability to identify and respond appropriately to emergency situations make you a valuable team member.

• Your cheerful nature is contagious and actively contributes to a positive company culture that inspires our customers and enriches the working environment

• You have You are on the InterRAI HC course or have the willingness to complete it
What we are proud of

• Our priority is personal customer support and continuity through fixed caregivers. We focus on building long-term relationships.

• We offer flexibility in operational planning

• Employment is possible in the hourly wage and in the monthly wage

• You work independently and are still not alone – in the design of work you have freedom, in the team the exchange of experience and mutual support

• The extensive training offer of the Senevita Academy is free of charge for our employees

• We also offer lucrative employee benefits & partner benefits

You are empathetic, your passion is to care for people? Then you are exactly right with us! We look forward to your online application! Further information can be provided by Nikson Preqi, site manager.

descriptionByLocale.en:
Senevita is the largest integrated provider of services in old age and employs around 4,300 people. Outpatient and stationary offers merge seamlessly. While the Senevita locations stand for independent assisted living and comprehensive care, Senevita Casa is the leading provider of private Spitex services throughout Switzerland. If a warm relationship with your fellow human beings is the be-all and end-all for you, you are enthusiastically committed to older people, team spirit and joy in working are your top priority, then we have missed you!

For the Senevita Sunnwies in Islikon we are looking for a Dipl immediately or by agreement. Nurse with additional function RAI responsibility 80 - 100%
Your tasks

• Professional and individual care and care of residents on the conceptual basis of the model of supporting process care

• Planning, implementation and evaluation of nursing measures in compliance with the criteria of the nursing process and involving the affected residents and their caregivers.

• Co-creation of an optimal interdisciplinary cooperation with all services involved in the care and care process

• Assuming daily responsibility

• Careful and seamless management of care documentation

• Accurate recording of care and care services as well as the care and consumable materials used.

• RAI responsibility:

• Implementation and safeguarding of timely RAI assessments in accordance with legal and operational requirements.

• Responsibility for the correct classification of care needs as well as the care classification of residents.

• Creation, review and ongoing updating of individual care planning based on the assessment results.

• Ensuring a complete, professional and comprehensible maintenance documentation.

• Advice and support to care professionals in the application of the RAI system and care planning.

• Monitoring assessment dates and ensuring data quality and completeness of documentation.

You bring that with you

• Completed professional training as a qualified nurse (HF, FH, AKP, DNII, DNI, PSYKP) or equivalent diploma recognised by the SRC

• Experience in long-term care and dealing with the elderly

• Experience with the RAI system

• User knowledge of the software CareCoach (maintenance documentation) is an advantage

• Empathetic and resilient personality with high commitment

• Very good written and oral German skills
We offer you

• Extensive and free training on the Senevita Campus and in the Senevita Academy, which inspires ongoing development

• Free intermediate meals (bread, fruit, coffee and mineral), as well as min. 50% discount in our own restaurants

• Attractive Senevita benefits (SBB half-ax, fleet discounts, participation in fitness subscription, discount on Senevita holiday apartments, various partner discounts, etc.)

• Generous holiday regime (at least 5 weeks, from 50 years 6 weeks and from 60 years 7 weeks)

• Regular team events and shared experiences that strengthen cooperation

• Our statement "closer to people" counts for our employees as much as for our residents.

Is this the challenge you are looking for? Our helpful and dedicated team is looking forward to meeting you! We look forward to your online application incl. CV, relevant diplomas and employment certificates.

• Completed professional training as a qualified nurse (HF, FH, AKP, DNII, DNI, PSYKP) or equivalent diploma recognised by the SRC

• Very good written and oral German skills

servizio giornaliero 100%

Senevita is the largest integrated provider of services in old age and employs around 4,000 people. Outpatient and stationary offerings merge seamlessly. While the Senevita locations stand for independent assisted living and comprehensive care, Senevita Casa is the leading provider of private Spitex services throughout Switzerland.

For the Senevita Regensberg in Zurich we are looking for a Dipl immediately or by appointment. Care professional HF or FH
in day service 100%
Your tasks

• With your knowledge and commitment, you contribute to ensuring that our residents enjoy professional and individual care and support every day.

• You are the first contact person for the team for technical questions and are happy to support our residents

• You can use your strengths and areas of interest in various topic areas
You bring that with you

• You have completed training as a Dipl. Nurse HF, FH or equivalent qualification recognised by the SRC

• You are a real team player. One for all, all for one – this is your and our motto

• You see challenging and varied care situations as a positive challenge and are committed to our residents

• You enjoy dealing with vulnerable people and long-term care

• What is particularly important to us: an appreciative cooperation and a personality that complements our team

• Good knowledge of German in words and writing
We offer you

• Flexible working hours: we respond to your service plan requirements and support your work-life balance (night service on request)

• Re-entrants are welcome: we appreciate your experience and facilitate re-entry or part-time work

• Your ideas are in demand and will be heard: actively shape the day-to-day care and take the opportunity to develop professionally as well as humanly.

• A working environment with heart: we are a highly motivated team that values professionalism, mutual appreciation and fun at work

• Central location: our location in the city of Zurich is optimally connected to public transport (Oerlikon railway station 400 m away, tram stop directly outside the door)

• Attractive further education offered by the Senevita Academy, which inspires ongoing development and opportunities to develop within the Senevita Group

• Good social benefits, attractive employee benefits and at least 5 weeks holidays (from 50 years 6 weeks, from 60 years 7 weeks)

• Regularly exciting activities / events that move and connect employees and residents.

• Our commitment: You as a person are important to us!

Take responsibility. Working in the team. Caring with heart. You're evolving.

Designazione delle merci

Sene Vita è il più grande fornitore integrato di servizi di vecchiaia e impiega circa 4.000 persone. I servizi ambulatoriali e ricoverati sono perfettamente intrecciati. Mentre Sene Vita location sono sinonimo di assistenza indipendente per la vita e l'assistenza completa, Sene Vita Casa è il fornitore leader di servizi privati Spitex in tutta la Svizzera.

Per il frutteto Sene VIA di Affoltern am Albis siamo alla ricerca di una persona affidabile e motivata come infermiera qualificata HF/FH 60- 100%

Cosa fai?

Nella nostra area protetta per persone con sviluppo di demenza o in una zona giorno aperta si assumono i seguenti compiti: - Assistenza professionale e individuale e cura dei residenti sulla base concettuale del modello di assistenza di processo di supporto - pianificazione, attuazione e valutazione delle misure di assistenza infermieristica in conformità con i criteri del processo di cura e con il coinvolgimento dei residenti colpiti e delle loro persone di riferimento - co-progettazione di una cooperazione interdisciplinare ottimale con tutti coloro che partecipano al processo di cura e assistenza -

Prendere la responsabilità del turno sul reparto e la responsabilità della casa - Gestione attenta e completa della documentazione di cura - Registrazione esatta dei servizi di cura e cura, nonché della cura e dei materiali di consumo utilizzati

Con cosa ti sei distinto?

- Formazione professionale completa come specialista qualificato in infermieristica (HF, FH, AKP, DNI, DNI, PSYKP) o diploma equivalente riconosciuto dalla SRK - esperienza in cure a lungo termine e nel trattamento con persone anziane - Conoscenza degli utenti del software CareCoach (documentazione di assistenza) di vantaggio - Personalità empatica e tycoon con grande disponibilità ad usare - Ottima conoscenza scritta e orale tedesca

Cosa puoi cercare?

- Formazione completa e gratuita al Campus Sene Vita e all'Accademia Sene Vita, che ispira lo sviluppo in corso - Pasti intermedi gratuiti (pane, frutta, caffè e minerali), oltre a un menu.

50% di sconto nei nostri ristoranti interni - Attraente Sene Vita-Benefits (SBB-Half-Tax, sconti sulla flotta, partecipazione all'abbonamento fitness, sconto sugli appartamenti vacanza Senevita, vari sconti partner, ecc.) - Ottimi accordi per le vacanze (almeno 5 settimane, da 50 anni 6 settimane e da 60 anni 7 settimane) - Eventi regolari di squadra ed esperienze congiunte che rafforzano il rapporto - La nostra dichiarazione "più vicino all'essere umano" conta per i nostri dipendenti e per i nostri residenti.

Contatto

È esattamente questa la sfida che stai cercando? Il nostro team disponibile e impegnato è impaziente di incontrarti! Non vediamo l'ora di ricevere la tua domanda online, tra cui CV, diplomi pertinenti e certificati di lavoro. Vuoi saperne di più? Allora saremo felici di aiutarti:

Compiti

Nella nostra zona giorno protetta per persone con sviluppo di demenza o in una zona giorno aperta si assumono i seguenti compiti: - Assistenza professionale e individuale e cura dei residenti sulla base concettuale del modello di assistenza di processo di supporto - Registrazione esatta dei servizi di assistenza e di assistenza, nonché la cura e consumabili utilizzati

Requisiti

- Formazione professionale completa come specialista qualificato in infermieristica (HF, FH, AKP, DNI, DNI, PSYKP) o diploma equivalente riconosciuto dal SRC - Ottima conoscenza del tedesco per iscritto e orale

Offriamo

- Formazione completa e gratuita sul Campus di Sene Vita e all'Accademia di Sene Vita, che ispira lo sviluppo continuo

Description

Sene Vita is the largest integrated provider of services of old age and employs around 4,000 people. Outpatient and inpatient services are seamlessly intertwined. While Sene Vita locations stand for independent cared for living and comprehensive care, Sene Vita Casa is the leading provider of private Spitex services throughout Switzerland.

For the Sene VIA orchard in Affoltern am Albis we are looking for a reliable and motivated person as a qualified nurse HF/FH 60- 100%

What You Do

In our protected living area for people with a dementia development or in an open living area you take over the following tasks: - Professional and individual care and care of the residents on the conceptual basis of the model of the supporting process care - planning, implementation and evaluation of nursing measures in compliance with the criteria of the care process and with the involvement of the affected residents and their reference persons - co-design of an optimal interdisciplinary cooperation with all involved in the care and care process -

Take over of shift responsibility on the department as well as the house responsibility - Careful and complete management of the care documentation - Exact recording of the care and care services as well as the used care and consumables

What you're distinguished with

- Completed vocational training as a qualified nursing specialist (HF, FH, AKP, DNI, DNI, PSYKP) or equivalent diploma recognised by the SRK - experience in long-term care and in dealing with older people - User knowledge of the CareCoach software (care documentation) of advantage - Empathic and tycoon personality with high willingness to use - Very good written and oral German knowledge

What You Can Look For

- Comprehensive and free training on the Sene Vita Campus and in the Sene Vita Academy, which inspires the ongoing development - Free intermediate meals (bread, fruits, coffee and mineral), as well as a menu.

50% discount in our in-house restaurants - Attractive Sene Vita-Benefits (SBB-Half-Tax, fleet discounts, participation in fitness subscription, discount on Senevita holiday apartments, various partner discounts, etc.) - Great holiday arrangements (at least 5 weeks, from 50 years 6 weeks and from 60 years 7 weeks) - Regular team events and joint experiences that strengthen the relationship - Our statement "closer to the human being" counts for our employees as well as for our residents.

Is this exactly the challenge you are looking for? Our helpful and committed team is looking forward to meeting you! We look forward to receiving your online application including CV, relevant diplomas and work certificates. Would you like to know more? Then we will be happy to help you:

Tasks

- Completed vocational training as a qualified nursing specialist (HF, FH, AKP, DNI, DNI, PSYKP) or equivalent diploma recognised by the SRC - Very good knowledge of German in writing and oral

• Attraktive Senevita-Benefits (SBB-Halbtax, Flottenrabatte, Beteiligung an Fitnessabo,

• Experience in long-term care and dealing with the elderly

• User knowledge of the software CareCoach (maintenance documentation) is an advantage

• Empathic and resilient personality with high commitment

• Very good written and oral German skills

jobs.description:
Senevita ist die grösste integrierte Anbieterin von Dienstleistungen im Alter und beschäftigt rund 4'000 Mitarbeitende. Ambulante und stationäre Angebote gehen nahtlos ineinander über. Während die Senevita Standorte für selbstständiges betreutes Wohnen und umfassende Pflege stehen, ist Senevita Casa die schweizweit führende Anbieterin privater Spitex-Leistungen.

Für die Senevita Burgdorf suchen wir per sofort   oder nach Vereinbarung eine achtsame und teamorientierte Person als  Fachfrau / Fachmann Gesundheit EFZ 60 % - 100 %
 Deine Aufgaben

• Du stellst eine individuelle, ganzheitliche und bewohnerorientierte Pflege und Betreuung sicher, die die Lebensqualität der Bewohnenden in den Mittelpunkt stellt

• Du unterstützt die Bewohnenden aktiv dabei, ihre vorhandenen Fähigkeiten zu erhalten und zu fördern und beziehst sie in die Entscheidungen bezüglich ihrer Pflege ein

• Du erkennst frühzeitig Veränderungen im Gesundheitszustand der Bewohnerinnen und Bewohner, dokumentierst diese präzise und leitest entsprechende Massnahmen ein

• Du pflegst einen empathischen und transparenten Austausch mit Angehörigen und Bezugspersonen und stehst als kompetente Ansprechperson zur Verfügung

• Du beteiligst dich aktiv an der Weiterentwicklung unserer Pflegequalität und bringst deine Ideen zur Optimierung von Prozessen ein
 Das bringst du mit

• Eine abgeschlossene Ausbildung als Fachfrau-/mann Gesundheit EFZ oder eine gleichwertige, in der Schweiz anerkannte Ausbildung

• Idealerweise bringst du bereits mehrjährige Berufserfahrung in der Langzeitpflege mit - auch Wiedereinsteiger/-innen sind herzlich Willkommen

• Du hast ein grosses Herz für ältere Menschen und legst Wert auf eine wertschätzende, empathische und bewohnerzentrierte Pflege

• Du arbeitest gerne im Team, bist hilfsbereit und respektvoll im Umgang mit Kolleginnen und Kollegen und trägst aktiv zu einem positiven Arbeitsklima bei

• Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse sind für die Kommunikation mit unseren Bewohnern und im Team unerlässlich
 Wir bieten dir

• Die Möglichkeit, sehr selbständig zu arbeiten und sich mit einem erfahrenen Team auszutauschen

• Umgangreiches und kostenloses Weiterbildungsangebot auf dem Senevita Campus und der Senevita Akademie, welches zur laufenden Weiterentwicklung inspiriert

• Vergünstigte Verpflegung in der hauseigenen Gastronomie

• Attraktive Senevita-Benefits (SBB-Halbtax, Tanken, Zusatzversicherungen, Fitness, Apotheke etc.)

• Regelmässige Teamanlässe und gemeinsame Erlebnisse, die das Miteinander stärken

• Grosszügige Ferienregelung

Senevita è il più grande fornitore integrato di servizi in età avanzata e impiega circa 4.000 persone. Le offerte ambulatoriale e stazionario si fondono senza soluzione di continuità. Mentre le sedi di Senevita sono per la vita assistita indipendente e la cura completa, Senevita Casa è il fornitore leader di servizi privati Spitex in tutta la Svizzera.

Per Senevita Burgdorf stiamo cercando una persona consapevole e orientata al team come specialista / sanitario EFZ 60% - 100%
I tuoi compiti

• Garantisci cure e cure individuali, olistiche e orientate ai residenti che si concentrano sulla qualità della vita dei residenti

• Supporti attivamente i residenti nel mantenere e promuovere le loro capacità esistenti e coinvolgerli nelle loro decisioni di cura

• Riconosce i primi cambiamenti nello stato di salute dei residenti, li documenta con precisione e avvia misure appropriate

• Si mantiene uno scambio empatico e trasparente con parenti e caregiver e sono disponibili come persona di contatto competente

• Partecipate attivamente all'ulteriore sviluppo della nostra qualità di cura e contribuite alle vostre idee per l'ottimizzazione dei processi
Lo porti con te.

• Formazione completa come specialista sanitario EFZ o una formazione equivalente riconosciuta in Svizzera

• Idealmente, hai già diversi anni di esperienza professionale nella cura a lungo termine - anche re-entrants sono benvenuti

• Hai un grande cuore per le persone anziane e la cura apprezzativa, empatica e residente

• Ti piace lavorare in un team, sono utili e rispettosi nel trattare con i colleghi e contribuire attivamente a un ambiente di lavoro positivo

• Molto buona conoscenza del tedesco è essenziale per la comunicazione con i nostri residenti e nel team
Vi offriamo

• L'opportunità di lavorare in modo molto indipendente e scambiare idee con un team esperto

• Formazione completa e gratuita sul Campus Senevita e l'Accademia Senevita, che ispira lo sviluppo continuo

• Cibo scontato nella gastronomia interna

• Prestazioni interessanti Senevita (SBB semiasse, carburante, assicurazione complementare, fitness, farmacia, ecc.)

• Eventi di squadra regolari e esperienze condivise che rafforzano la cooperazione

• Generoso regime di vacanza

• La nostra affermazione "più vicina alle persone" conta per i nostri dipendenti tanto quanto per i nostri residenti

descriptionByLocale.en:
Senevita is the largest integrated provider of services in old age and employs around 4,000 people. Outpatient and stationary offerings merge seamlessly. While the Senevita locations stand for independent assisted living and comprehensive care, Senevita Casa is the leading provider of private Spitex services throughout Switzerland.

For the Senevita Burgdorf we are looking for a mindful and team-oriented person as a specialist / health professional EFZ 60% - 100%
Your tasks

• You ensure individual, holistic and resident-oriented care and care that focuses on the quality of life of the residents

• You actively support the residents in maintaining and promoting their existing abilities and involve them in their care decisions

• You recognize early changes in the health status of the residents, document them precisely and initiate appropriate measures

• You maintain an empathetic and transparent exchange with relatives and caregivers and are available as a competent contact person

• You actively participate in the further development of our care quality and contribute your ideas to the optimization of processes
You bring that with you

• Completed training as a specialist health EFZ or an equivalent training recognised in Switzerland

• Ideally, you already have several years of professional experience in long-term care - even re-entrants are welcome

• You have a big heart for older people and value appreciative, empathetic and resident-centered care

• You enjoy working in a team, are helpful and respectful in dealing with colleagues and actively contribute to a positive working environment

• Very good knowledge of German is essential for communication with our residents and in the team
We offer you

• The opportunity to work very independently and exchange ideas with an experienced team

• Comprehensive and free training on the Senevita Campus and the Senevita Academy, which inspires ongoing development

• Discounted food in the in-house gastronomy

• Attractive Senevita benefits (SBB half-ax, fueling, supplementary insurance, fitness, pharmacy, etc.)

• Regular team events and shared experiences that strengthen cooperation

• Generous holiday regime

• Our statement "closer to people" counts for our employees as much as for our residents
Interested?
Does this passage speak to you? An enthusiastic and open team as well as warm residents are looking forward to you! Please send us your online application.

For more information, please contact:

Tasks
• You ensure individual, holistic and resident-oriented care and care that focuses on the quality of life of the residents

• You actively participate in the further development of our care quality and contribute your ideas to the optimization of processes

Requirements
• Completed training as a specialist health EFZ or an equivalent training recognised in Switzerland

• Very good knowledge of German is essential for communication with our residents and in the team

We offer
• The opportunity to work very independently and exchange ideas with an experienced team

• Our statement "closer to people" counts for our employees as much as for our residents

While the Senevita locations stand for independent assisted living and comprehensive care, Senevita Casa is Switzerland's leading provider of private Spitex services. We are looking for the Senevita in Burgdorf from January 1st. January 2026 a mindful and team-oriented person as a health specialist FaGe EFZ 80-100% - late shift only
• Your tasks You will ensure individual, holistic and resident-oriented care and support that focuses on the quality of life of the residents You actively support the residents in maintaining and promoting their existing skills and include them in the decisions regarding their care You recognize changes in the residents' health at an early stage and document them precisely and initiate appropriate measures You maintain an empathetic and transparent exchange with relatives and caregivers and are available as a competent contact person You actively participate in the further development of our care quality and contribute your ideas for optimizing processes
• What you bring with you Completed training as a health specialist EFZ or an equivalent training recognized in Switzerland Ideally, you already have several years of professional experience in long-term care - also Those returning to work are warmly welcome. You have a big heart for older people and value appreciative, empathetic and resident-centered care. You enjoy working in a team, are helpful and respectful when dealing with colleagues and actively contribute to a positive working atmosphere. Very good knowledge of German is essential for communication with our residents and in the team.
• We offer you the opportunity to work very independently and exchange ideas with an experienced team Senevita Campus and the Senevita Academy, which inspires ongoing development Discounted meals in the in-house restaurant Attractive Senevita benefits (SBB half-fare card, refueling, additional insurance, fitness, pharmacy, etc.) Regular team events and shared experiences that strengthen cooperation Generous holiday regulations Our statement "Closer to people" counts for our employees as well as our residents Interested? • Requirements Completed training as a health specialist (EFZ) or equivalent training recognized in Switzerland Ideally, you already have several years of professional experience in long-term care - those returning to work are also welcome You have a big heart for older people and value appreciative, empathetic and resident-centered care You enjoy working in a team, are helpful and respectful when dealing with colleagues and actively contribute to a positive working atmosphere. Very good knowledge of German is essential for communication with our residents and in the team.

 Dein wichtiger Beitrag

• Du spielst eine massgebliche Rolle dabei, sicherzustellen, dass unsere Kundinnen und Kunden zu Hause eine erstklassige und individuelle Bezugspflege geniessen.

• Du Verantwortest die Verabreichung von Medikamenten und Durchführung medizinischer Aufgaben und die Betreuung von unseren Kundinnen und Kunden.

• Du bist mit der Fallführung eng im Austausch und wirkst aktiv im Pflegeprozess mit.

Senevita is the largest integrated provider of services in old age and employs around 4,000 people. Outpatient and stationary offerings merge seamlessly. While the Senevita locations stand for independent assisted living and comprehensive care, Senevita Casa is the leading provider of private Spitex services in Switzerland. For the Senevita Casa Lucerne in Ebikon we are looking for a specialist health in monthly or hourly wage 40 - 60 %
Your important contribution

• You play a key role in ensuring that our customers enjoy first-class and individual care at home.

• You are responsible for administering medicines and carrying out medical tasks and taking care of our customers.

• You are in close contact with the case management and actively participate in the care process.
With this you enrich our team

• Your flexibility and commitment make you a reliable support in the team

• Your good oral and written German skills will help you communicate with the people around you

• Your sense of responsibility and ability to identify and respond appropriately to emergency situations make you a valuable team member.

• Your cheerful nature is contagious and actively contributes to a positive company culture that inspires our customers and enriches the working environment

• Advantageously, you own your own car and live in the region
What we are proud of

• Our priority is personal customer support and continuity through fixed caregivers. We focus on building long-term relationships.

• We offer flexibility in operational planning

• Employment is possible in the hourly wage and in the monthly wage

• You work independently and are still not alone – in the design of work you have freedom, in the team the exchange of experience and mutual support

• The extensive training offer of the Senevita Academy is free of charge for our employees

• We also offer lucrative employee benefits & partner benefits

Descrizione Sene Vita è il più grande fornitore integrato di servizi di vecchiaia e impiega circa 4.000 dipendenti. Ambulanza e standage offrono un'unione senza soluzione di continuità. Mentre Sene Vita location sono sinonimo di assistenza indipendente e di vita completa, Senevita Casa è il fornitore leader di servizi privati Spitex in tutta la Svizzera.

Per il treno Sene Vita Casa stiamo cercando il treno regione di accordo uno specialista di salute EFZ in ore o salario mensile 40- 100% - Spitex

Compiti - Lei assiste i nostri clienti nella cura di base - Lei si prende cura della cura professionale - Lei svolge la documentazione di cura in modo completo e indipendente - Lei è strettamente in collaborazione con la gestione dei casi e partecipa attivamente al processo di cura - Lei assume anche compiti amministrativi e organizzativi se necessario

Requisiti - Hai una formazione come un professionista della salute - Ti trai da un lavoro responsabile e consapevole della qualità - Hai un piacere nel trattare con gli anziani e sono impegnati nei compiti di versatile - Vantaggio di fornire esperienza professionale in assistenza a lungo termine - Vantaggio di possedere un'auto e soggiornare nella regione

Offriamo - La nostra priorità è la cura personale dei clienti e la continuità attraverso i caregiver fissi. Ci affidiamo alla costruzione di relazioni a lungo termine.

- Offriamo flessibilità nella pianificazione delle operazioni - L'occupazione è possibile in salari mensili e stipendi orari - Siamo in molti a cambiare il lavoro quotidiano ogni giorno - La possibilità di lavorare indipendentemente e scambiare idee con un team esperto - L'offerta di formazione completa della Sene Vita Academy è gratuita per i nostri dipendenti - Offriamo anche dipendenti lucrativi con una gamma di vantaggi

Contatto Sei empatetico, la tua passione è per la cura delle persone, e si prova resilienza? Allora hai esattamente ragione con noi!

Non vediamo l'ora di la tua applicazione online!
descriptionByLocale.en:
Description Sene Vita is the largest integrated provider of services of old age and employs around 4,000 employees. Ambulant and stationary offers seamlessly merge. While Sene Vita locations stand for independent cared for living and comprehensive care, Senevita Casa is the leading provider of private Spitex services throughout Switzerland.

For the Sene Vita Casa train we are looking for the region train by agreement a specialist health EFZ in hours or monthly wage 40- 100% - Spitex

Tasks - You support our customers in basic care - You take care of the professional treatment care - You carry out the care documentation completely and independently - You are closely in exchange with the case management and actively participate in the care process - You also take over administrative and organizational tasks if necessary

Requirements - You have a training as a health professional - You draw yourself out by your own responsible and quality-conscious work - You have a pleasure in dealing with older people and are committed to the versatile tasks - Advantage of providing professional experience in long-term care - Advantage of owning a car and staying in the region

We offer - Our priority is personal customer care and continuity through fixed caregivers. We rely on building long-term relationships.

- We offer flexibility in the planning of operations - The employment is possible in monthly wages and hourly wages - We experience a lot of change in everyday work every day - The possibility of working independently and exchanging ideas with an experienced team - The comprehensive training offer of the Sene Vita Academy is free of charge for our employees - We also offer lucrative employees with a range of benefits

Contact You are empathetic, your passion is for the care of people, and you prove resilience? Then you are exactly right with us!

We look forward to your online application!

jobs.description:
Senevita Casa è il servizio Spitex privato di Senevita, dedicato all’assistenza ambulatoriale a domicilio. Offriamo prestazioni personalizzate per favorire l’autonomia e la qualità della vita delle persone anziane nel proprio ambiente domestico. Come parte del più grande fornitore privato di servizi per anziani in Svizzera, Senevita Casa integra la nostra rete di residenze assistite e strutture di cura, portando supporto professionale direttamente a casa.
 Per la sede Senevita Casa Ticino - Regione Luganese - , cerchiamo da subito:
 Infermiera/e dipl. – Servizio notturno 40–100%
 Responsabilità

• Garantire durante la notte un’assistenza infermieristica sicura, professionale e personalizzata al domicilio dei nostri clienti.

• Valutare le condizioni cliniche, riconoscere tempestivamente eventuali cambiamenti e definire le priorità assistenziali.

• Assistere e sorvegliare persone con situazioni cliniche complesse e bisogni assistenziali elevati, inclusi pazienti che necessitano di supporto respiratorio.

• Gestire con competenza situazioni impreviste e di urgenza, attivando quando necessario il medico o i servizi di emergenza.

• Garantire la corretta esecuzione delle prescrizioni medico-infermieristiche e il rispetto degli standard di qualità e sicurezza.

• Documentare gli interventi e assicurare un passaggio di consegne preciso e completo al team.

• Collaborare con medici, familiari, caregiver e altri professionisti coinvolti nella presa in carico.
 Requisiti

• Diploma di infermiera/e (Bachelor SUPSI, diploma SSSCI o titolo estero riconosciuto in Svizzera).

• Comprovata esperienza professionale in Pronto Soccorso, Cure Intense, Cure Intermedie/IMC o in un contesto di cure acute ad alta complessità.

• Capacità di valutazione clinica, definizione delle priorità e gestione autonoma delle situazioni di urgenza.

• Esperienza nella presa in carico di pazienti con supporto ventilatorio costituiscono un importante titolo preferenziale.

• Elevato senso di responsabilità, affidabilità e capacità decisionale.

• Capacità di lavorare in autonomia durante il servizio notturno, mantenendo una stretta collaborazione con il team interdisciplinare.

• Precisione nella documentazione e nella trasmissione delle informazioni cliniche.

• Buone competenze relazionali, empatia e capacità di instaurare un rapporto professionale e rassicurante con pazienti e familiari.

• Disponibilità a lavorare prevalentemente in servizio notturno.

• Patente di guida e disponibilità agli spostamenti sul territorio.
 Offriamo

• Flessibilità nella pianificazione dei turni: possibilità di concordare le notti in base alla propria disponibilità, ideale anche per chi lavora già presso un’altra struttura e desidera integrare la propria attività con alcuni turni notturni.Un’attività infermieristica ad elevato grado di autonomia e responsabilità professionale.

• La possibilità di mettere a frutto competenze maturate in area acuta e intensiva in un contesto di assistenza domiciliare individualizzata.

• Un’organizzazione strutturata e il supporto di un team interdisciplinare.

• Formazione continua e possibilità di sviluppo delle competenze professionali.

• Utilizzo delle auto aziendali durante il servizio.

• Condizioni di lavoro e percentuale d’impiego da concordare in funzione del profilo.

Vuoi mettere la tua esperienza clinica al servizio delle persone anche al loro domicilio?
 Entra a far parte di Senevita Casa Ticino e contribuisci a garantire continuità, sicurezza e qualità dell’assistenza anche durante la notte.
 Per qualsiasi domanda, non esitate a contattare telefonicamente o per mail la nostra sede:
 Senevita Casa Ticino
Via Pian Scairolo 7 | 6912 Pazzallo-Lugano
Telefono +41 91 950 85 85
ticino@senevita.ch | www.senevitacasa.ch

Aufgaben
• Garantire durante la notte un’assistenza infermieristica sicura, professionale e personalizzata al domicilio dei nostri clienti.

• Collaborare con medici, familiari, caregiver e altri professionisti coinvolti nella presa in carico.

Anforderungen
• Diploma di infermiera/e (Bachelor SUPSI, diploma SSSCI o titolo estero riconosciuto in Svizzera).

• Patente di guida e disponibilità agli spostamenti sul territorio.

Wir bieten
• Flessibilità nella pianificazione dei turni: possibilità di concordare le notti in base alla propria disponibilità, ideale anche per chi lavora già presso un’altra struttura e desidera integrare la propria attività con alcuni turni notturni.Un’attività infermieristica ad elevato grado di autonomia e responsabilità professionale.

Senevita Casa is the private Spitex service of Senevita, dedicated to outpatient care at home. We offer customized performance to promote the autonomy and quality of life of older people in their home environment. As part of the largest private provider of elderly services in Switzerland, Senevita Casa integrates our network of assisted residences and care facilities, bringing professional support directly to home.
For Senevita Casa Ticino - Region Luganese - , we are looking for:
Nurse/e dipl. – Night service 40–100%
Liability

• Ensure safe, professional and personalized nursing at the home of our customers during the night.

• Evaluate clinical conditions, quickly recognize any changes and define care priorities.

• Assist and supervise people with complex clinical situations and high welfare needs, including patients who need respiratory support.

• Manage unexpected and urgent situations with competence, activating when necessary the doctor or emergency services.

• Ensure the correct execution of medical-infirmary requirements and compliance with quality and safety standards.

• Document interventions and ensure a precise and complete delivery pass to the team.

• Collaborate with doctors, family, caregiver and other professionals involved in taking charge.
Requirements

• Degree of nurse (Bachelor SUPSI, SSSCI diploma or foreign qualification recognized in Switzerland).

• Professional experience in ER, Cure Intense, Cure Intermedie/ IMC or in a context of high complexity acute care.

• Clinical assessment, priority definition and autonomous management of emergency situations.

• Experience in taking care of patients with ventilating support is an important preferential title.

• High sense of responsibility, reliability and decision-making.

• Ability to work independently during the night service, maintaining close collaboration with the interdisciplinary team.

• Accuracy in the documentation and transmission of clinical information.

• Good relational skills, empathy and ability to establish a professional and reassuring relationship with patients and family.

• Availability to work mainly in night service.

• Driving licence and availability to travel on the territory.
We offer

• Flexibility in shift planning: possibility of agreeing nights according to your availability, also ideal for those who already work at another facility and want to integrate their activity with some night shifts. A nursing activity with a high degree of autonomy and professional responsibility.

• The possibility to exploit skills gained in acute and intensive area in an individualized home care context.

• A structured organization and support of an interdisciplinary team.

• Continuous training and opportunities for the development of professional skills.

• Use of company cars during service.

• Working conditions and percentage of use to be agreed according to the profile.

Do you want to put your clinical experience at the service of people even at their home?
Join Senevita Casa Ticino and help ensure continuity, security and quality of assistance even during the night.
For any questions, please feel free to contact us by phone or e-mail:
Senevita Casa Ticino

Phone +41 91 950 85 85

Senevita Casa ist der private Spitex-Service von Senevita, der sich der ambulanten Versorgung zu Hause widmet. Wir bieten maßgeschneiderte Leistung, um die Autonomie und Lebensqualität älterer Menschen in ihrer häuslichen Umgebung zu fördern. Als Teil des größten privaten Anbieters von Seniorendienstleistungen in der Schweiz integriert Senevita Casa unser Netzwerk von betreuten Wohnhäusern und Pflegeeinrichtungen und bringt professionelle Unterstützung direkt nach Hause.
Für Senevita Casa Ticino - Region Luganese - suchen wir:
Krankenschwester / e dipl. - Nachtdienst 40-100%
Haftung

• Sorgen Sie für eine sichere, professionelle und personalisierte Pflege zu Hause bei unseren Kunden während der Nacht.

• Bewerten Sie die klinischen Bedingungen, erkennen Sie schnell Änderungen und definieren Sie Pflegeprioritäten.

• Unterstützung und Überwachung von Menschen mit komplexen klinischen Situationen und hohen Wohlfahrtsbedürfnissen, einschließlich Patienten, die Atemunterstützung benötigen.

• Verwalten Sie unerwartete und dringende Situationen mit Kompetenz und aktivieren Sie bei Bedarf den Arzt oder den Notfalldienst.

• Gewährleistung der korrekten Durchführung der medizinischen Anforderungen und der Einhaltung der Qualitäts- und Sicherheitsstandards.

• Dokumentieren Sie Interventionen und sorgen Sie für einen präzisen und vollständigen Lieferausweis an das Team.

• Arbeiten Sie mit Ärzten, Familienangehörigen, Betreuern und anderen Fachleuten zusammen, die an der Übernahme der Verantwortung beteiligt sind.

My name is Senevita and I am one of the leading providers in the field of long-term care and care. I have many exciting apprenticeships to offer; in care, in the hotel industry; in the commercial sector as well as in company maintenance. At the moment, about 210 learners are trained with me. Already cool, right? I am really proud of that!

Do you want to be a part of us? We have 1. August 2027 the following free apprenticeship:
Koch/Köchin EFZ
This is what awaits you
Together with the kitchen team, you will create "gush" seasonal and regional dishes. You take food, prepare it skilfully and make sure it is done beautifully. We show you how we pay attention to an age-appropriate diet in everyday life and use as few finished products as possible. In addition, you also ensure good cooperation between you and the service staff.
You bring that with you

• School education completed

• Flexibility and pleasure in dealing with food

• Reliability as well as creativity and joy of trying new things

• Sense of order and cleanliness

• Team spirit and good manners
This is what we offer you
We make you a professional in your field! This includes professional training with motivated and highly qualified vocational trainers. You will receive individual support and get an accurate insight into the various tasks. We encourage creativity and look forward to your fresh ideas. You will also benefit from our attractive employment conditions and paid teaching materials.
Further information

Nessun giorno è lo stesso: si lavora con le persone, prendere la responsabilità passo dopo passo e imparare qualcosa di nuovo ogni giorno. Potete scoprire i vostri punti di forza, svilupparvi e dare un prezioso contributo al benessere dei nostri abitanti.
Durante la vostra formazione, accompagnate e sostenete i nostri residenti nella loro vita quotidiana. Ad esempio, li aiuti con cura personale, vestibilità e fodera, nutrizione e attività quotidiane. Imparerai a rispondere alle esigenze e alle abitudini individuali dei nostri residenti e a promuovere la loro indipendenza.
Prendere anche semplici compiti di cura e guardare con attenzione come i nostri residenti stanno facendo. Si passa alle modifiche ai professionisti responsabili.
Le attività di pulizia e di organizzazione fanno parte anche della vostra varia giornata lavorativa. Si lavora a stretto contatto con il vostro team e vari professionisti e aiutare i nostri residenti a sentirsi al sicuro e a proprio agio con noi.
Con noi puoi aspettarti una formazione biennale versatile e pratica. Vi accompagneremo nella vostra strada per diventare un assistente sanitario e sociale EBA e vi supporteremo nello sviluppo delle vostre competenze personali e professionali.
Lo porti con te.

• Avete completato la scuola obbligatoria e siete motivati a iniziare a lavorare e imparare cose nuove.

• Avete una buona conoscenza del tedesco nelle parole e nella scrittura.

• Sei interessato al campo di cura emozionante e versatile e divertiti a lavorare con le persone.

• Si avvicina ai nostri residenti con sensibilità, rispetto e apertura.

• Siete affidabili, orientati al servizio e in grado di comprendere e implementare rapidamente nuove cose.

• Si lavora con attenzione e responsabilmente e sono pronti a prendere la responsabilità.

• Vi piace lavorare in una grande squadra e sono felici di contribuire i vostri punti di forza e idee.

• Porti spirito di squadra, umorismo e buone maniere.

• Siete fisicamente e psicologicamente resilienti e mantenere una testa fresca anche in situazioni difficili.
Questo è ciò che vi offriamo
Con noi alla Fonderia Senevita ti mettiamo in forma per il tuo futuro!
Si può aspettare una formazione professionale e varia, accompagnata da formatori professionali motivati e altamente qualificati.
Vi sosteniamo individualmente e vi diamo una visione versatile delle diverse aree di cura. Potete scoprire i vostri punti di forza, imparare cose nuove e assumere sempre più responsabilità passo dopo passo.
La vostra creatività e le vostre idee sono i benvenuti – non vediamo l'ora di dare un nuovo contributo e creare nuove cose insieme a voi.
Attività e eventi emozionanti forniscono regolarmente esperienze condivise che si muovono e connettono dipendenti e residenti.
E soprattutto, tu come persona sei importante per noi!
Inoltre, voi beneficiate di condizioni di lavoro interessanti e copriamo i costi per i vostri materiali didattici.

Abbiamo avuto il tuo interesse? Allora non vediamo l'ora della vostra applicazione online! Per ulteriori informazioni rivolgersi a: Daniela Perroni
